{"metadata":{"description":"Recall and re-run the current session's command history with ↑/↓ keys in the DSH Web composer.","id":"gh:1333730644","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-history","slug":"xuender/dsh-history","topics":["cordis","deepseek","dsh","dsh-plugin","history"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Recall and re-run the current session's command history with ↑/↓ keys in the DSH Web composer."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-history — DSH Web command history plugin"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Remembers the **current session's** command history in the DSH Web GUI: with the composer input focu"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"sed, press **↑ / ↓** to step through previously sent commands, edit them, and press Enter to re-send"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ed, press **↑ / ↓** to step through previously sent commands, edit them, and press Enter to re-send."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Recording** — every message you send in the current session (plain messages and `/xxx` slash com"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"mands) is recorded automatically, isolated per session. History is derived from the session log (`us"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"er`/`command` nodes), so it is rebuilt automatically after a page reload — no extra storage needed.
"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"- **↑** — step back to the previous command; keep pressing to go further back. The first press saves"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" the draft you were editing, and pressing ↓ afterwards returns to it.
- **↓** — step forward to a ne"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"wer command; from the newest entry, one more ↓ returns to the saved draft.
- **Edit & re-run** — a r"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ecalled command lands in the composer draft; edit it directly and press Enter to re-send.
- **Safe f"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"allbacks** — while a `/` or `@` trigger menu is open, during IME composition (e.g. Chinese input), w"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"hen the composer is busy/locked, or when the input is not focused, ↑/↓ keep their native behavior an"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"s busy/locked, or when the input is not focused, ↑/↓ keep their native behavior and never interfere."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 📦 Installation"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The plugin is a standard DSH static plugin (see the develop/basic tutorial). The entry name must be "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"the **bare package name** `dsh-history`, and the package directory must be resolvable from both reso"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"lution trees (the host loader resolves the bare name from the DSH installation's `node_modules`; the"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" client-modules scanner resolves `dsh-history/package.json` upward from the profile directory), so t"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"wo symlinks are required:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Then launch with the patch:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Or merge the `cordis.yml` contents (the `insert` stanza) into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.y"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ml` to load it permanently."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 🗂️ Directory layout"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## ⚙️ How it works"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Client-module mechanism** — the package declares `dsh.client: { platform: "web" }` with `exports"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"["./client"]` pointing at `lib/client.js`; `dsh-client-modules` then bundles that entry into `window"},{"id":"p16s3","text":".__DSH_BOOT__` and serves it at `/plugins/<entry>/client.js`. The browser side registers the plugin "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`.
- **Recording** — a component registered on"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" the `conversation.input.dock` slot subscribes to the session snapshot (`useSession((s) => s.nodes)`"},{"id":"p16s6","text":") and incrementally scans `user`/`command` nodes by `seq` (the list is seq-ascending and untruncated"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"), collapsing adjacent duplicates, capped at 100 entries, stored in a module-level `Map<sessionId, …"},{"id":"p16s8","text":">`.
- **Navigation** — a capture-phase `keydown` listener on `document` takes over ↑/↓ only when the"},{"id":"p16s9","text":" focus is inside `[data-composer-card]`, no trigger menu is open (`claim` is empty), not composing I"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"ME input, no modifier keys are held, and the composer is not busy — writing the draft via `inputActi"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"ons.setDraft(text)`. The editing check returns you to the live position automatically after you type"},{"id":"p16s12","text":".
- **Indicator** — while browsing, a small “history n/m” badge is shown above the composer."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## ⚠️ Limitations"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- History is per-session and in-memory (rebuilt from the session log after a page reload, so nothing"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" is lost within a session; it is discarded when the browser closes).
- Slash commands are recalled a"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"s `/name args` (from `command` nodes).
- Image-only messages (no text) are not recorded."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 🤝 Community"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Contributing Guide — how to report bugs, request features, and open pull requests (including begin"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ner-friendly `good first issue` tasks).

- Security Policy — how to report a vulnerability privately.
